scientific_integrity: Exact-algebra proof with independent finite rational consistency checks; no claim of external certification or established historical uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Scalar strongly convex quadratic plus strictly positive absolute-value penalty only.
The threshold is sharp for all-initialization boundedness below and existence of prescribed-start escaping trajectories above, with no equality-case classification.
No global convergence conclusion below the threshold, no complete periodic-orbit classification above it.
The Schur frontier of the smooth linear update is established in earlier work; the composite invariant-cone and antipodal-cycle conclusions are the comparison target.
title: An antipodal escape threshold for the scalar Prox-NAG-GS method
